messages:
maria: Quick sync: adding a short "geo processing" footnote for EU/CA residency. Need SDK snippet, migration guide, and l10n. cc @kim @jason

kim: Legal prefers "processed" not "routed". Will get approved one-liner; also asks to point strict customers to Redwood Private.

jason: I'll add REDWOOD_REGION env var example and a tiny FAQ entry for fallback behavior.

henry: I'll update JS + curl samples. Show recommended header `X-Redwood-Region` and alias `X-Region`. Add fallback note: server may return 503 + `X-Redwood-Fallback: global`.

eva: Keep legal sentence as one translatable string. l10n-bot please open job with context.

l10n-bot: created T-999: "geo processing footnote". Context attached. Moving to ready for translation.

maria: Action items: kim confirm legal, henry update snippets + fallback, jason publish migration PR with checklist, eva trigger translations. I'll review PRs after lunch.

henry: PR opened with samples and inline footnote anchor. Requesting review from @maria and @kim.

kim: Legal approved exact sentence; leaving comment on PR. Marketing will extract short blurb after merge.

jason: Migration PR merged; I added changelog and linked T-999.

maria: Thanks all. Archive thread and link PRs in docs checklist. End.
